result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B says plainly that the form is already sound and names what works: visible labels, correct input types and autofill, the optional field marked, and a specific button. Each of its small changes has a reason tied to the person filling in the form, such as 16px text so phones don't zoom and a 44px tap target. A never says the form works and adds more decoration, like a card border and a full-width branded button, mostly justified by looks, though it keeps the markup intact and makes nothing worse. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A says plainly that the form is already sound and names what works: visible labels, input types, autofill, the optional marking and the specific button. Each change it makes has a user-facing reason, such as 16px text so phones don't zoom, a 44px tap target and a visible focus ring. B keeps the markup just as intact, but it never says the form was already good, and it adds more decoration (a card and a full-width button) mostly for looks.
